request: AI Core read-only investigate why guarded cutover stops after quiescence; inspect existing Gate key presence/transfer length without revealing its value, model state no mutation

bounded_host_request.command:
set -u
echo "GATE_RUNNING=$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' ai-core-model-gate)"
docker exec ai-core-model-gate python3 -c 'import os; print("IN_CONTAINER_KEY_PRESENT="+str(bool(os.environ.get("AI_CORE_API_KEY"))))'
value="$(docker exec ai-core-model-gate python3 -c 'import os;print(os.environ["AI_CORE_API_KEY"],end="")' 2>/dev/null)"
code=$?
echo "KEY_TRANSFER_RETURN=$code KEY_LENGTH=${#value}"
unset value
for name in granite qwen3 ministral coder; do echo "MODEL_$name=$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "ai-$name")"; done
gh api -X POST repos/G-ACE-inc/server-core/issues/10/comments -f "body=AI_CORE_UDS_KEY_TRANSFER_DIAG Gate/4model read-only; see correlated command stdout for only booleans and key length" --jq .html_url
